statements.subject: client
statements.description: The requesting client SHOULD retry the request at the new address(es) given by the Contact header field. The Request-URI of the new request uses the value of the Contact header field in the response.
actions: retry request at Contact header URI

statements.subject: client
statements.description: If there is no explicit expiration time, the address is only valid once for recursing, and MUST NOT be cached for future transactions.
statements.trigger: 302 Moved Temporarily received with no expiration time
actions: use Contact URI for single recursion only
do not cache Contact URI for future transactions

statements.subject: client
statements.description: If the URI cached from the Contact header field fails, the Request-URI from the redirected request MAY be tried again a single time.
